Fixes #341114, #341025, #341113.

<!-- Thank you for submitting a Pull Request. Please:
* Read our Pull Request guidelines:
  https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/wiki/How-to-Contribute#pull-requests
* Associate an issue with the Pull Request.
* Ensure that the code is up-to-date with the `main` branch.
* Include a description of the proposed changes and how to test them.
-->

## Motivation

Cloud automation cards give no immediate confirmation when a run starts, and remote edits stay stale until a manual refresh. This change adds pending-run feedback, a refresh progress indicator, and automatic refresh while the Automations view is visible.

<details>
<summary>Code stats</summary>

- **Total diff (current):** +471/-68
- **Implementation:** +126/-32 across 5 files
- **Tests:** +344/-35 across 3 files, 12 added
- **Documentation:** +1/-1 across 1 file
- **Split:** 29.3% implementation, 70.3% tests, 0.4% documentation
- **Changed-line coverage:** 96.8% (122/126)

<details>
<summary>Where the change lives</summary>

- `src/vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/test/browser/automationsView.test.ts`: +268/-31 (55.5%)
- `src/vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/browser/views/automationsView.ts`: +104/-31 (25.0%)
- `src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/copilotChatSessions/test/browser/cloudAutomationStore.test.ts`: +58/-4 (11.5%)
- `src/vs/sessions/contrib/automations/test/browser/providerAutomationService.test.ts`: +18/-0 (3.3%)
- `src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/copilotChatSessions/browser/cloudAutomationStore.ts`: +12/-0 (2.2%)
- `src/vs/sessions/contrib/automations/browser/providerAutomationService.ts`: +5/-0 (0.9%)
- `src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/copilotChatSessions/browser/githubCloudAutomationStore.ts`: +3/-1 (0.7%)
- `src/vs/sessions/AUTOMATIONS.md`: +1/-1 (0.4%)
- `src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/common/automations/automationService.ts`: +2/-0 (0.4%)

</details>
</details>

<details>
<summary>Change breakdown</summary>

| Category | What it does | Implementation | Tests |
|---|---|---|---|
| Refresh state and cached catalogue | Expose provider-neutral progress without disabling cached definitions | +22/-1 | +76/-4 |
| Card and refresh UI | Show run progress, handle refresh clicks and poll the visible view every minute | +104/-31 | +268/-31 |
| **Total** | | **+126/-32** | **+344/-35** |

- **Refresh state and cached catalogue:** `automationService.ts`, `providerAutomationService.ts`, `providerAutomationService.test.ts`, `cloudAutomationStore.ts`, `cloudAutomationStore.test.ts`, `githubCloudAutomationStore.ts`
- **Card and refresh UI:** `automationsView.ts`, `automationsView.test.ts`
- **Documentation:** `AUTOMATIONS.md` (+1/-1) describes the refresh lifecycle.

</details>

## Changes made

- Show the shared loading spinner to the right of the card title and replace the prompt with "Starting run..." until a new run appears or the request fails. Fixes [#341114](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/341114).
- Replace the Refresh label with an icon that shows the loading spinner during refresh. Background refresh stays clickable; clicking it waits for the active refresh instead of starting another. Cached cards remain editable. Fixes [#341025](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/341025).
- Load the list when Automations opens, then refresh every 60 seconds after the previous refresh finishes while the view remains visible. Window focus changes do not trigger requests; manual Refresh remains available. Preserve the provider's existing 15-second active-history and bounded-discovery checks. Fixes [#341113](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/341113).
- Keep Refresh behind the existing automations flag, expose spinner progress with `aria-busy`, and log automatic refresh failures without repeated error toasts. Preserve pending cloud-run feedback when an unrelated host is disconnected.

<details>
<summary>Validation</summary>

- `npm run build-fast -- --client-only`: passed.
- The three affected suites, including the current native-cloud-session tests: **190 passed**, no failures.

```powershell
.\scripts\test.bat --per-test-coverage --reporter full-json-stream --run src\vs\sessions\contrib\sessions\test\browser\automationsView.test.ts --run src\vs\sessions\contrib\automations\test\browser\providerAutomationService.test.ts --run src\vs\sessions\contrib\providers\copilotChatSessions\test\browser\cloudAutomationStore.test.ts
```

Coverage uses the existing per-test V8 reporter, the installed `@bcoe/v8-coverage` and `v8-to-istanbul` libraries, source-map conversion to LCOV, and intersection with added implementation lines. Four changed lines remain uncovered. One old timer-based test was replaced; the twelve added cases include both parameterized refresh outcomes.

- Changed-file TypeScript check: **passed**, zero diagnostics across all eight changed TypeScript files, using the project configuration and this command.

```powershell
@'
import ts from 'typescript';import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process';import path from 'node:path';
const raw=ts.readConfigFile('src\\tsconfig.json',ts.sys.readFile);const config=ts.parseJsonConfigFileContent(raw.config,ts.sys,path.resolve('src'));
const base=execFileSync('git',['merge-base','HEAD','origin/main'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();
const files=execFileSync('git',['diff','--name-only','--diff-filter=ACM',base],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim().split('\n').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.ts')).map(f=>path.resolve(f));
const program=ts.createProgram(config.fileNames,{...config.options,noEmit:true});
const diagnostics=[...program.getOptionsDiagnostics(),...files.flatMap(f=>{const source=program.getSourceFile(f);if(!source){throw Error(f);}return [...program.getSyntacticDiagnostics(source),...program.getSemanticDiagnostics(source)];})];
console.log(ts.formatDiagnosticsWithColorAndContext(diagnostics,{getCurrentDirectory:ts.sys.getCurrentDirectory,getCanonicalFileName:f=>f,getNewLine:()=> '\n'}));console.log(`Checked ${files.length} changed TypeScript files: ${diagnostics.length} diagnostics`);process.exitCode=diagnostics.length?1:0;
'@ | node --max-old-space-size=8192 --input-type=module
```

- Changed-file lint: **passed**, all eight files.

```powershell
$base = git merge-base HEAD origin/main
$files = @(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACM $base -- '*.ts')
npm run eslint -- $files
```

- `git diff origin/main...HEAD --check`: passed.
- Commit hygiene: passed.
- All 23 Automations Light fixtures rendered headlessly with zero errors.
- No interactive Code OSS, smoke, or integration runs were performed for this revision.

Manual checks with GitHub sign-in and `chat.automations.enabled` / `chat.automations.cloud.enabled` on:

1. Run a safe manual automation. The spinner appears right of the stationary title, the prompt changes to "Starting run...", and another click cannot dispatch a duplicate. New queued history restores the prompt; a failed request reports an error and clears feedback.
2. Click Refresh from idle, then during a background refresh. The spinner animates; only the click disables the button, and it re-enables when refresh settles. A click during refresh starts no extra request. Open a card while the catalogue is refreshing.
3. Leave Automations visible for 60 seconds after refresh finishes: another refresh starts. Switch away from and back to the window before the next interval: no extra refresh should start. Hide Automations for more than 60 seconds: its list timer stops. Reopening reloads the list.
4. Disable the automations setting: Refresh is hidden. Re-enable it: Refresh returns. Existing active-history polling is unchanged and remains provider-owned.

</details>
items.title: automations: improve 'running' state and automatic refresh

items.body:
## Why

[43f74c4](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/43f74c456fae43f78ccd51c23333bd80aeb7b27b) fixed #332031 by passing `_conversationId` to extension-provided models for prompt caching. The Agent Host BYOK proxy already has the SDK session ID, but drops it before reaching the provider.

This forwards that ID through the existing `modelOptions._conversationId`, preserving the other model options. Regression tests cover repeated requests, separate sessions, tool continuations, and forwarding to the language model service.

Related: #337203 proposes a public session-ID API alongside request middleware. This patch uses the existing private field.

## Testing

The proxy, Responses translation, and renderer handler suites pass (56 tests), as does lint on the changed files. Run them with `./scripts/test.sh --runGlob '**/{byokLmProxyService,byokResponsesTranslation,agentHostByokLmHandler}.test.js'` after building client output.

<!-- Thank you for submitting a Pull Request. Please:
* Read our Pull Request guidelines:
  https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/wiki/How-to-Contribute#pull-requests
* Associate an issue with the Pull Request.
* Ensure that the code is up-to-date with the `main` branch.
* Include a description of the proposed changes and how to test them.
-->

## Summary

Keep inventory-owned cloud conversation entries when the live host omits them from its session list, in both the Editor and Agents windows. Previously, refreshing an empty live list could remove an open conversation and cancel its pending recorded-history request before any content appeared.

Related to #340354. This complements **#340815**, which fixes failed live-history results replacing recorded content. This PR fixes only list retention; it does not duplicate that PR's history-loading changes. Both fixes are needed for the two separately observed failure paths. No separate tracking issue was supplied.

- Reuse the existing inventory-ownership check to protect the Agents-window session adapter from list-refresh eviction.
- Add an opt-in retention predicate to the Editor's shared list store, enabled only for the inventory-owned cloud resource. Retain entries before calculating removals, while continuing to apply workspace filtering.
- Allow discovery to seed missing Editor entries while connected. Existing live metadata still takes precedence over discovery.
- Keep normal eviction for host-only sessions, including another provider with the same raw ID, and preserve explicit deletion and teardown behavior.
- Key retained entries and list mutations by provider plus the exact backend resource. Sessions with the same path but different authorities or queries remain distinct through rendering, notifications, archive/read actions, and deletion.
- Resolve rows through the existing identity registry, keeping backend fragments separate from frontend chat selectors. Reuse the existing subagent-selector stripping logic without discarding real session query fields.

No new protocol fields, settings, persistence, notifications, or timers.

## Validation

### Import-cycle correction (`698fea03273`)

The preceding follow-up introduced a runtime cycle from `chatSessionsService` to `constants` and back. The failed Compile & Hygiene job and local cycle checker reported the same cycle. Move the unchanged selector helper alongside its constant in `constants.ts` and update its three callers; no new module or behavior change. This correction does not include the separate per-row registry-lookup simplification.

Using Node 24.18.0:

```sh
# Passed: refreshed client test output.
npm run build-fast -- --client-only

# Passed: no cyclic dependencies in 10,198 files.
npm run check-cyclic-dependencies

# Passed: all 10 identity regression tests, including subagent selectors and backend fragments.
./scripts/test.sh \
  --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.test.ts \
  --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/agentSessions/agentHostChatContribution.test.ts \
  --grep 'same-path|fragment-bearing|repository scope \(ahp-session' \
  --reporter dot

# Passed.
npm run eslint -- \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/common/chatSessionsService.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/common/constants.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionHandler.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionListController.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/cloudSandboxSessionListController.ts

# Passed, and passed again for the final staged files in the commit hook.
node build/hygiene.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/common/chatSessionsService.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/common/constants.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionHandler.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionListController.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/cloudSandboxSessionListController.ts

# Passed.
git diff --check
```

The helper body and signature are unchanged. Live cloud and graphical end-to-end flows were not run.

### Exact-resource review follow-up (`64440297b0f`)

Addressed [the exact-resource retention finding](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/341443#discussion_r4265988355). Using Node 24.18.0, **198 focused tests passed**, including ten new tests for same-provider authority/query collisions, notifications, inventory versus host actions, repository attribution, working-directory resolution, pending/read state, and a singleton fragment-bearing backend session. Six initial Editor regressions failed before the identity fix. Two independently reviewed selector regressions were reproduced and corrected before the final passing run.

```sh
# Passed.
npm run build-fast -- --client-only
npm run typecheck-client

# Passed: 198 tests.
./scripts/test.sh \
  --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.test.ts \
  --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/agentSessions/agentHostChatContribution.test.ts \
  --grep 'Editor cloud sandbox|AgentHostChatContribution (session list|session ID resolution|IAgentConnection config)' \
  --reporter dot

# Passed for all seven follow-up files; the final three edited files were also rechecked.
npm run eslint -- \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionListStore.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionListController.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionHandler.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/cloudSandboxSessionListController.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/common/chatSessionsService.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.test.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/agentSessions/agentHostChatContribution.test.ts

# Passed for all seven files, and on the final staged versions in the commit hook.
node build/hygiene.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionListStore.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionListController.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionHandler.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/cloudSandboxSessionListController.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/common/chatSessionsService.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.test.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/agentSessions/agentHostChatContribution.test.ts

# Passed.
git diff --check
```

The follow-up was reviewed by two independent reviewers and the corrections received a focused source recheck. Live cloud and graphical end-to-end flows were **not run**.

### Initial retention fix (`c0ce79803f0`)

Using Node 24.18.0. **255 focused tests passed**. The five new regression cases failed on the original implementation before the retention fix; coverage also checks non-empty same-provider lists, reconnect, live metadata updates without replacing the adapter, deletion, and discovery while already connected.

```sh
# Passed: client output for focused tests only; no workbench launch.
npm run build-fast -- --client-only

# Passed.
npm run typecheck-client

# Passed: 255 tests.
./scripts/test.sh \
  --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgentHost/test/browser/remoteAgentHostSessionsProvider.test.ts \
  --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.test.ts \
  --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/agentSessions/agentHostChatContribution.test.ts \
  --grep 'CloudSandboxSessionsProvider|Editor cloud sandbox|AgentHostChatContribution session list' \
  --reporter dot

# Passed for all seven changed files; the two test files were rechecked after review additions.
npm run eslint -- \
  src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgentHost/browser/remoteAgentHostSessionsProvider.ts \
  src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgentHost/browser/cloudSandboxSessionsProvider.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionListStore.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/cloudSandboxSessionListController.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.ts \
  src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgentHost/test/browser/remoteAgentHostSessionsProvider.test.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.test.ts

# Passed for all seven files, and again on the final staged versions in the commit hook.
node build/hygiene.ts \
  src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgentHost/browser/remoteAgentHostSessionsProvider.ts \
  src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgentHost/browser/cloudSandboxSessionsProvider.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionListStore.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/cloudSandboxSessionListController.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.ts \
  src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgentHost/test/browser/remoteAgentHostSessionsProvider.test.ts \
  src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.test.ts

# Passed.
git diff --check
```

Two independent code reviews found no blocking issues. Tests use the real list adapters with simulated connections. Live cloud and graphical end-to-end flows were **not run**.

## Manual Verification

1. Open an inventory-discovered cloud conversation while its recorded-history request is pending. Let the live host return an empty list, or a list containing another session from the same provider but omitting this one.
2. Confirm the original row/view remains and recorded history can finish loading instead of being cancelled by removal.
3. Let the host list the original conversation again. Confirm its metadata updates without creating a second entry or replacing the Agents-window session adapter.
4. Remove the task through the existing deletion action, change accounts, or disable cloud discovery. Confirm the existing cleanup still applies. Host-only sessions omitted from a successful list must still disappear.
5. Repeat with a host-only session that shares the inventory root's provider and path but differs in authority or query. Both entries must remain distinct, and updating, archiving, or deleting the host-only entry must not change or delete the inventory task. A singleton backend URI containing a fragment must still open its default chat; subagent editors must retain their own session's remote working directory.

<details>
<summary>Review path and decisions (about 7 minutes)</summary>

**Example (1 minute):** inventory owns `ahp-session:/original-session`. The user opens it and the host returns `items: []`. The inventory, not presence in the live host list, determines whether that saved conversation is still listed. These are illustrative values, not a claimed live reproduction.

**Editor wiring (1 minute):** [editorCloudSandboxContribution.ts](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/c0ce79803f0cbb7d6b9c2a8c0b8e18f6d8f83da6/src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.ts#L158) supplies the inventory predicate to [cloudSandboxSessionListController.ts](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/c0ce79803f0cbb7d6b9c2a8c0b8e18f6d8f83da6/src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/cloudSandboxSessionListController.ts#L75), which checks the exact cloud root resource before enabling retention. Check that another provider or a child-chat resource cannot inherit ownership just by sharing an ID.

**Apply the live list (1 minute):** the shared store keeps the prior entry before computing its removal delta. The key must include the exact backend resource: `ahp-session:/original-session` and `ahp-session://other/original-session` are not the same session. The following guard is the most important in the PR: a listed entry is still updated normally, and an unlisted one survives only with explicit retention and valid workspace scope.

[agentHostSessionListStore.ts](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/64440297b0fbb39126afab8ed10ea05460230513/src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionListStore.ts#L327)
```ts
for (const entry of previousEntries) {
	const key = this._key(entry.provider, entry.summary.resource);
	if (!this._entries.has(key) && this._options.retainSession?.(URI.parse(entry.summary.resource)) && this._isSessionInWorkspace(entry)) {
		this._entries.set(key, entry);
		nextEntries.push(entry);
	}
}
```

**Project and act on the row (2 minutes):** [agentHostSessionListController.ts](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/64440297b0fbb39126afab8ed10ea05460230513/src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionListController.ts#L244) asks the existing registry for each exact backend resource's frontend row. Archive/read/delete actions resolve that row back to its exact backend resource, preferring a registered identity before stripping workbench-only chat selectors. [cloudSandboxSessionListController.ts](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/64440297b0fbb39126afab8ed10ea05460230513/src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/cloudSandboxSessionListController.ts#L169) also separates working directories, repository membership, and inventory archive/delete ownership. Check that preserving two store entries never produces two indistinguishable frontend rows or sends an action to the inventory root by mistake.

**Agents-window equivalent (1 minute):** [cloudSandboxSessionsProvider.ts](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/c0ce79803f0cbb7d6b9c2a8c0b8e18f6d8f83da6/src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgentHost/browser/cloudSandboxSessionsProvider.ts#L340) uses the existing eviction hook and existing inventory ownership predicate, retaining the same cached adapter rather than constructing a replacement. Check the new [history retention tests](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/c0ce79803f0cbb7d6b9c2a8c0b8e18f6d8f83da6/src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgentHost/test/browser/remoteAgentHostSessionsProvider.test.ts#L5029), then the [pending-history regression](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/c0ce79803f0cbb7d6b9c2a8c0b8e18f6d8f83da6/src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.test.ts#L1003).

**Decisions and limits (1 minute):**
- Retention follows the existing inventory lifetime, not a grace timeout. Existing discovery policy preserving connected environments is unchanged; this is not a redesign of cross-client task-removal reconciliation.
- Removing the Editor's connected-only seeding restriction is intentional: the store already prevents discovery from overwriting live metadata, but must accept a newly discovered missing entry.
- Explicit host removal notifications retain their existing meaning. A later inventory discovery may reseed a cloud entry; no new tombstone system is introduced.
- The identity registry's existing conflict guard is unchanged. Root backend fragments are not copied into UI peer-chat selection; both kinds of identity are tested separately. The subagent-selector helper is extracted from existing handler logic, not a new protocol interpretation.
- This does not fix live-history promotion, provision replacement sessions, or establish why a particular host lost its conversation. Those are separate concerns, including #340815.

</details>
items.title: chat: preserve cloud sessions omitted by live hosts
